description: This source file implements the basic functions for a string component object in a modular system. It includes functions for creating, removing, enrolling objects, and initializing a string component object, including property setters and getters. The code defines the lifecycle and core behaviors of a custom string object within a component framework.

classes.name: ANSC_STRING_OBJECT
classes.description: The main object structure representing the string component, including function pointers for string operations and properties like OID and name.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscStringCOCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new string component object, setting function pointers and properties.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscStringCORemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the string component object, freeing allocated memory.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscStringCOEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrolls required dependent objects for the string component.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscStringCOInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the string component object, setting its properties and function pointers.
